en.headline: Squash team home after Asian Games gold and four other medals
en.dek: Mixed-doubles pair Tang Ming-wai and Lee Ka-yee said they had not expected an all-Hong Kong final in Nagoya.
body: Hong Kong's squash team returned on Saturday night after taking one gold, two silvers and two bronzes at the Asian Games in Nagoya, RTHK reported.

Mixed-doubles gold medallists Tang Ming-wai and Lee Ka-yee said they were pleased with the result. Lee said the pair had been seeded lower before the event and had not expected much, and that it was more satisfying that two Hong Kong pairs filled the final. Tang said he was glad to see the progress of the younger opponents they faced for the title.

Squash Association chairman Yau Tat-kan said he was proud of the haul. He said Hong Kong had collected 28 medals in squash since the sport joined the Asian Games programme, and thanked athletes and the government for their support.

Association president Mui Ying-yuen said Hong Kong's strength was in doubles. He said the association had already asked the Olympic Council of Asia, at a meeting on Saturday morning, to add men's and women's doubles at the next Games.

zh.headline: 壁球代表隊返港 混雙金牌組合稱未敢期望太多
zh.dek: 港台報道，名古屋亞運奪得一金兩銀兩銅的壁球隊周六晚返抵香港，鄧銘漮、李嘉兒指決賽由兩對港隊包辦更值得高興。
body: 港台報道，在名古屋亞運奪得一金、兩銀、兩銅的中國香港壁球代表隊，周六晚上返抵香港。
混合雙打金牌組合鄧銘漮、李嘉兒表示對奪金感到開心。李嘉兒說，開賽前二人種子排名較低，沒有期望太多，決賽由兩對港隊組合包辦金、銀牌，更加值得高興。鄧銘漮則說，看到決賽對手師弟妹一直進步，感到欣慰。
壁球總會主席邱達根表示，對港隊成績深感驕傲。他說，自從亞運加入壁球項目後，港隊合共獲得28面獎牌，是取得較多獎牌的項目之一，並感謝運動員多年來的付出，以及政府投入資源支援。
會長梅應源表示，港隊在雙打項目有優勢。他說，周六早上與亞奧理事會開會時，已提出在下一屆亞運增加男雙和女雙，期望港隊再爭取更好成績。
